title: Seminar in Computational Linguistics
description: Predictive Processing and Sentence Structure. This seminar will focus on two closely related facts about language understanding. First, processing sentences fundamentally involves relating sequential input with underlying hierarchical structure; and second, there is a large body of work suggesting that sentence processing involves an interplay between top-down predictions and bottom-up evidence. We will establish background and look at relevant literature from multiple perspectives, including psycholinguistics, neurolinguistics, and computational modeling.
